Padding and Headroom above are ESTIMATES: this project still needs Tempo Anchors, and they are what put region starts on bar lines. Both are measured against bar lines, so both move with the grid. Run this again after applying to see exact figures.

WHAT THIS CHECK CANNOT SEE
